definitions.gloss: hairdressing; hair styling; grooming one's hair
definitions.explanation: The act of arranging or styling hair to make it neat and presentable. Composed of 整 (arrange/put in order) + 髪 (hair). Used as a noun or suru-verb.

examples.japanese: {整髪料|せいはつりょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つけて→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{整|ととの}えた→整える：04259_totonoeru⟧。
examples.english: I used hair styling product to arrange my hair.

examples.japanese: ⟦{面接|めんせつ}→面接：01100_mensetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{整髪|せいはつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧おいた⟦ほうがいい→ほうがいい：10078_hougaii⟧。
examples.english: You should groom your hair before the interview.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{整髪|せいはつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{時間|じかん}がかかる→時間がかかる：26082_jikangakakaru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{短|みじか}い→短い：00510_mijikai⟧⟦{髪型|かみがた}→髪型：14646_kamigata⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{変|か}えよう→変える：01089_kaeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}っている→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: Styling my hair takes time every morning, so I'm thinking of switching to a shorter hairstyle.

notes:
USAGE:
{整髪|せいはつ} is most commonly encountered in the compound {整髪料|せいはつりょう} (hair styling product — gel, wax, mousse, etc.). On its own, it sounds somewhat formal.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {整髪料|せいはつりょう} (hair styling product)
- {整髪|せいはつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (style/groom one's hair)
- {整髪|せいはつ}⟦スプレー→スプレー：11581_supuree⟧ (hairspray)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦セット→セット：03853_setto⟧ refers to styling hair and is the common casual term (e.g., ⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦セット→セット：03853_setto⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧). {整髪|せいはつ} is more formal. ヘアスタイリング is the loanword equivalent used in fashion contexts.
